introduction: Explore the lake, battlefield, forest and crypt of the Barrow of the Quiosho. Meet the old warrior and prepare his head-for-amulet exchange while following leads about restless spirits, Borrix’s salvage and the swanmay.
orientation: Enter from a current Surface tributary or estuary. Learn the river, lake, battlefield and forest routes and prepare a safe return.
Seek the old orcish warrior beyond the overgrown battlefield. He exchanges the exact bloody head of the elven king for a Blood-eye amulet.
Bring the head loose in your inventory. A recovered or supplied copy fits without your own king victory, crypt exploration or earlier questions.
The crypt’s coffins suggest a recovery route. The head, preserved elven remains and warhorse remains are different items; ordinary remains do not satisfy the warrior’s request.
Some grate, weeds and drain passages start hidden and closed. Find an actual passage before opening it, and prepare for the water and drain hazards.
A guardian’s key fits the wooden crypt doors. Borrix’s chest uses a different key. Having a key is separate from finding, unlocking and passing a door.
Borrix’s hut, the battlefield’s spirits and the burial panels offer leads about salvage and the battlefield’s past. The journal does not yet record a trade or spirit-release task here.
A glass eye associated with the skull monument has an existing exchange with a blind monk elsewhere. Recovering the eye here and completing his commission are separate milestones.
The regal swan and swanmay suggest a guardian story. Similar feathery tokens have different uses; the blessing scroll does not itself establish a transformation or rescue.
The warrior’s accepted exchange stays recorded after the head is spent. His reward, any useful army or loyalty outcome, and care for living animals or spirits remain distinct stories.

contacts.name: a sightless fish
contacts.description: Sightless fish inhabit the dark river. A visit or catch is separate from helping living wildlife.

contacts.name: a spoon-billed duck
contacts.description: Spoon-billed ducks inhabit the lake and shoreline. Recovering meat does not record animal care.

contacts.name: a large white swan
contacts.description: White swans share the lake. Any protection story needs a living animal and a useful result.

contacts.name: the regal swan
contacts.description: The regal swan carries a feathery token. Its appearance hints at a larger tale about the lake’s guardian.

contacts.name: the swanmay
contacts.description: The swanmay appears in the lake’s guardian lore. Her place in that tale is a lead to investigate.

contacts.name: Borrix, the goblin trader
contacts.description: Borrix inhabits the trader’s hut with salvage and a locked chest. The journal does not yet record a salvage commission or trade here.

contacts.name: a goblin scavenger
contacts.description: Goblin scavengers range across the battlefield. Loot recovery and helping a living traveler are separate stories.

contacts.name: the old orcish warrior
contacts.description: The old orcish warrior accepts the exact bloody head of the elven king for a Blood-eye amulet. A recovered or supplied copy fits. His army and loyalty lore suggests further story work.

contacts.name: the spirit of an elven warrior
contacts.description: Elven warrior spirits haunt the barrow. Learning their history and helping them find peace require different outcomes.

contacts.name: a guardian spirit
contacts.description: Guardian spirits defend the crypt. A key carried by one guardian fits its wooden doors; holding the key and passing the doors are separate milestones.

contacts.name: the spirit of an orcish warrior
contacts.description: Orcish warrior spirits linger on the battlefield. Their presence does not yet provide a recorded peaceful-release quest.

contacts.name: a giant maggot
contacts.description: Giant maggots inhabit burial chambers. Prepare for their encounters while choosing a safe route.

contacts.name: a wild boar
contacts.description: Wild boars inhabit the forest. Their meat can be recovered, while humane care needs a separate useful outcome.

contacts.name: Will-o-the-Wisp
contacts.description: Will-o-the-Wisp carries a sapphire. Recovering it does not by itself establish a restoration or care story.

contacts.name: a green slime
contacts.description: Green slimes inhabit the crypt. Their vial can hurt its user before restoring vitality, so it should not be described as a healing or rescue reward.

stories.title: The old warrior’s king-head commission
stories.summary: Offer the exact bloody head of the elven king for a Blood-eye amulet. A recovered or supplied copy fits without personal crypt or king-victory history. The accepted exchange is recorded separately from the warrior’s larger army and loyalty story.

steps.text: Carry the bloody head of the elven king
steps.hint: Bring one exact head loose in your inventory. A recovered or supplied copy fits; present possession does not claim personal crypt exploration or a king victory.

steps.text: Record the old warrior’s accepted exchange
steps.hint: The accepted head-for-amulet exchange stays recorded after the head is spent. Any further army or loyalty story needs its own useful outcome.
